title: Generating Wikipedia by Summarizing Long Sequences
whyNeeded: Section 3.1 says only that it uses a multi-layer Transformer decoder, a variant of the original transformer, citing this. The decoder-only variant — which sublayers were dropped and how the single stack is arranged — is defined there and is the architecture every result in this paper is produced by.

title: Fixing Weight Decay Regularization in Adam
whyNeeded: The paper says only 'a modified version of L2 regularization proposed in [37], with w = 0.01'. What the modification is, and why decoupling it from Adam's adaptive denominator changes the effective penalty, is entirely in that paper and is needed to reproduce the pre-training run.

title: Bridging Nonlinearities and Stochastic Regularizers with Gaussian Error Linear Units
whyNeeded: GELU is named without a formula and used at the 3072-dimensional point of every feed-forward sublayer. Its definition, the tanh approximation usually implemented, and the stochastic-regularizer motivation all live there.

title: Reasoning about Entailment with Neural Attention
whyNeeded: Sections 1 and 3.3 say the input transformations are derived from a traversal-style approach and cite this without defining it. The whole minimal-architecture-change claim rests on what that serialization actually is.

title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
whyNeeded: The paper gives one clause — a bytepair encoding vocabulary with 40,000 merges — and the reported token-level perplexity of 18.4 is measured in those units. The merge algorithm and segmentation procedure come from there.

title: Attention Is All You Need
whyNeeded: The model is this architecture minus the encoder, with masked attention and learned rather than sinusoidal positions. Every divergence stated in Sections 3.1 and 4.1 is stated relative to this reference.

title: Layer Normalization
whyNeeded: The paper's justification for its N(0, 0.02) initialization is that layernorm is used extensively throughout the model. Whether that argument holds depends on what layernorm normalizes and where it sits.
